items.title: Uncategorized Papers

children.title: MUSIC-Synthetic dataset
children.description: Category-balanced multi-source videos by artificially synthesizing solo videos from the MUSIC dataset, to facilitate the learning and evaluation of multiple-soundings-sources localization in the cocktail-party scenario.

children.title: FAIR-Play
children.description: 1,871 video clips and their corresponding binaural audio clips recorded in a music room

children.title: VideoCC
children.description: A dataset containing (video-URL, caption) pairs for training video-text machine learning models. It is created using an automatic pipeline starting from the Conceptual Captions Image-Captioning Dataset.

children.title: ssw60
children.description: A dataset for research on adiovisual fine-grained categorization. The dataset covers 60 species of birds that all occur in a specific geographic location: Sapsucker Woods, Ithaca, NY. It is comprised of images from existing datasets, and brand new, expert curated audio and video data.

children.title: PACS
children.description: A dataset designed to help create and evaluate a new generation of AI algorithms able to reason about physical commonsense using both audio and visual modalities.
